summary: Today's full expanded search produced 26 detailed documentation-reviewed guides, including 12 completions from the earlier review queue, plus 30 additional screened discoveries. The new music-notation field covers desktop, Android and browser recognition; other additions span paper folding, neural relighting, editable layered artwork, agent-assisted 3D/game production and perfume-themed audiovisual interpretation. All 251 planned repository queries and 14 model-task queries were attempted across 39 fields, with 0 failed/partial attempts. The observation retains 19,858 repository candidates after supplementary archiving, plus 661 model leads. 95 repository searches reached result bounds; Codeberg and SourceHut remain explicit access gaps. Counts describe bounded discovery observations, not quality approvals or exhaustive coverage. New library guides are documentation baselines unless a concrete update is identified. Full software licenses were archived and reviewed for all eligible entries; model restrictions, proprietary hosts and unavailable demos are identified separately. No discovered software was installed or executed.

category_notes.text: SANA and imaginAIry receive detailed image-generation guides, while Inpaint-web covers learned inpainting. SANA image-model memory figures must not be applied to its separate video family.

OpenMontage, Pixelle-Video, OpenCreator and local trailer orchestration expose editable production stages. OpenMontage Studio is still a private alpha; the open-source engine is distinct from access to that hosted interface.

onbgm supplies editable symbolic scores and deterministic instrument rendering; Sheet Music MCP creates rehearsal audio. This is a different workflow from generating an opaque waveform, and sample/model permissions vary.

OOOSplat completes an earlier reconstruction lead. Relighting research pages add material/light-control ideas, but NeAR has no verified software license and TRHM has an additional README use-condition ambiguity.

Velocut and Inpaint-web are browser-oriented creative tools; their compute/storage/browser requirements differ. Primary Immersive Web SDK guidance provides additional web-authoring context without repeating its unchanged library entry.

Reviewed the Immersive Web SDK AI workflow, examples and headset-testing guidance again. Agent-assisted authoring is useful, but desktop preview does not establish headset interaction, comfort or runtime performance.
onbgm note-level YAML, Gesso editable game artwork and Animate procedural scenes make AI output inspectable as structured media. AntV Infographic provides an existing structural SVG reference.
sam-ui adds mask corrections and per-object review; MCP-connected editors make AI revisions inspectable. Immersive Web SDK describes interactive spatial authoring, with device testing still required.

FoldForge receives a guide for paper cut-and-fold designs; Fabricator and MCP build123d are screened CAD/printing leads. Geometric checks and export formats do not establish material strength, slicer suitability or successful fabrication.

Gesso authors editable game art; AI Game Studio and Metroidvania Studio become screened editor leads. Scene-aware movement research adds experimental character staging rather than a production-ready rig or collision system.

Afford-Motion gets a complete research guide for language- and scene-conditioned human movement. Its affordance-map stage is explicit, but rig conversion, contact quality and physical plausibility remain untested here.

PuppetStudio is screened for talk-to-puppet animation using speech recognition and learned facial motion. Body-motion work offers another avatar building block; both need separate identity, data and model-rights review.

sam-ui provides learned video masks and AI Texture connects depth-guided generation to Painter layers. Relighting primary research demonstrates another VFX direction, but unresolved software grants remain outside eligible additions.

Neural Acoustic Fields remains relevant context for learned room-dependent sound. OOOSplat addresses visual reconstruction; this research does not establish a combined ready-to-use audiovisual installation system.
OOOSplat documents COLMAP/Brush reconstruction and Gaussian-scene exports. Relighting research pages were inspected for capture-to-material workflows; splats are not automatically printable meshes.

SmartSub, Velocut and Patchy receive complete guides for subtitles, timeline editing and editable layered artwork. OpenMontage’s primary site was checked against its engine-versus-Studio availability distinction.
Gesso and Patchy retain vector source structures; Inkscape MCP becomes a screened lead. AntV Infographic’s live site supplies a separate example of AI-assisted structured SVG authoring.

Type Evidence receives a font-discovery guide with unresolved checkpoint terms and a negative small-study result disclosed. Draw Your Font remains useful primary context; it is not repeated as an unchanged new discovery.

ViMax and Pixelle-Video expose scripts, storyboards and shot generation; Animate provides code-authored stories. OpenMontage’s hosted Studio remains private alpha, so public engine source does not imply public Studio access.

Presenton offers editable slide exports across documented desktop/source routes, while Patchy and vector tools support editable visual layouts. Hosted features, local models and assistant services retain separate costs and terms.
Inpaint-web and imaginAIry support learned photographic processing. Keep originals and inspect changed detail; this review does not establish faithful restoration or a universal low-memory workflow.
AntV Infographic’s primary site was reviewed again for structured visual explanation. Animate adds procedural diagram/motion possibilities; checking facts and the underlying data remains essential.
Line-us MCP and morningprint add physical drawing/printing leads. OpenVJ was checked but has no substantive verified change, so its earlier library guide is preserved without repeating it as new.
cypher-dj adds an agent-and-human DJ performance lead. OpenVJ and Ghost Arcade remain existing references without an unchanged re-profile; neither venue latency nor live audio hardware was tested.

Primary SewFormer material remains promising for image-to-sewing-pattern research, but a verified complete software license was not established. Earlier NeuralTailor coverage remains available without an unchanged re-profile.
homr, Andromr and Sheet Music MCP can make printed scores editable or audible; SmartSub supports caption workflows. Recognition, voice separation, timing and language errors require human correction.

Andromr adds an Android on-device score-recognition guide. The Google Play page could not be inspected, so current store/device compatibility is unverified; its BUILDING document provides a separate debug-APK route.
Presenton, Animate and score-recognition tools support teaching slides, animated explanations and rehearsal material. Every generated fact, diagram, note and pronunciation remains subject to review.

Score scanning extends preservation coverage beyond photographs and film. homr/oemer can turn images into MusicXML, but originals must be retained because recognition is lossy and may omit notation details.

Added music notation, neural relighting and olfactory practice to the search plan. New research also reaches paper folding, robot drawing and perfume-themed audiovisual interpretation; ScentSoul does not synthesize physical scent.
HapticGen’s primary page was revisited. No substantive new change was established, so its existing profile is not recycled; model permissions remain separate from application code.

Reviewed MIT-IBM’s Neural Acoustic Fields account of learned room acoustics. No newly cleared end-user acoustic application emerged from this run; the research remains context rather than a new quality recommendation.

OpenMontage, OpenCreator, Gesso, Patchy and Sheet Music MCP expose concrete creative operations to agents. Local project files do not by themselves mean that a connected remote assistant receives no content.

Animate supplies procedural lettering and explanatory motion in editable scenes. Type Evidence helps select fonts; the live Draw Your Font page supplies adjacent type-authoring context. Font and reference-image rights remain separate.

Afford-Motion receives a research guide for movement conditioned on language and scene affordances. This supports staging experiments, not a guarantee of dance quality, human feasibility or ready-to-use game animation.

FoldForge adds AI-assisted paper patterns; Line-us MCP and morningprint connect agents to physical marks. Kolam Studio uses speech recognition to control procedural patterns. SewFormer/NeuroKnitting remain adjacent research with incomplete released-software verification.

New detailed guides cover homr, Andromr and Sheet Music MCP; oemer and ScanScore are additional screened leads. PyClef has a package but no verified repository software grant and stays on the watchlist.

NRHints receives a complete research guide and Blender-NRP is a screened proxy-lighting lead. TRHM and NeAR offer primary demonstrations but remain watchlist items because of conflicting or missing software permission evidence.

ScentSoul is screened for perfume-themed LLM-authored visuals, ambient audio and story cards, not physical scent generation. Smell & Paste provides non-AI interface context; NOSE is scientific research, and other olfactory projects remain unlicensed or unfinished.

Reviewed AI Texture’s depth-ControlNet-to-Painter workflow and Inkscape MCP’s vector editing integration. The Painter host is proprietary. The artist’s separate portfolio failed to open, so repository screenshots and setup carry that evidence.

Read primary pages for homr, Presenton, OpenMontage, Immersive Web SDK, AntV Infographic and related tools. OpenMontage Studio remains private alpha. Several demos were inaccessible; no app interaction/output testing is implied.

Paired Afford-Motion/SANA primary pages with released code and full licenses; separately investigated TRHM, NeAR, haptics, acoustics and olfactory interfaces. Missing or conflicting software permissions remain explicit watchlist gaps.

Reviewed Chinese Pixelle/OpenCreator/SmartSub/Dralo documentation, Spanish local trailer setup, and international score tools. Language is not an eligibility boundary; model restrictions and platform uncertainties are stated separately.

leads.name: AI Game Studio

leads.name: Metroidvania Studio

leads.name: MoChord

ai_relevance.text: The desktop workflow calls DeepSeek for structured chord progressions and practice plans; deterministic local generation is an explicitly separate fallback.

leads.review_status: React/Vite and Tauri workflows are documented in Chinese and English. Model/API access, desktop/mobile setup and audio-device compatibility need a complete guide. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: HOMR GUI
leads.good_for: Converting a captured score region to MusicXML and MIDI through a desktop interface.

ai_relevance.text: A PyQt6 front end exposes homr’s trained score-recognition pipeline with CPU or CUDA ONNX Runtime modes.

leads.review_status: Python 3.11–3.15 and Windows launchers are documented. Other-platform validation, mirrored model provenance and recognition accuracy need further review. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: Polyphonic TrOMR
leads.good_for: Researching polyphonic score digitization from rendered, printed or photographed notation.

ai_relevance.text: Released inference uses a transformer-based optical music recognition model to predict symbolic notation.

leads.review_status: Research implementation; README says training code will be released later. Inference setup, checkpoint terms and hardware review remain pending; benchmark claims were not repeated. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: Comfy web UI

leads.review_status: Actively changing interfaces; intended for trusted local networks with limited built-in defenses. Model/node requirements vary by recipe; no universal hardware minimum is established. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: mcp-score
leads.good_for: Generating MusicXML by conversation and editing a live MuseScore score with an assistant.

ai_relevance.text: An LLM writes music21 scripts and uses a MuseScore bridge to read or revise notation in context.

leads.review_status: Alpha; Python 3.14+ is advertised. The live bridge, notation-host setup and output musical correctness need full review. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: morningprint
leads.good_for: Producing a small physical artwork and verse on an 80 mm thermal receipt printer.

ai_relevance.text: Claude generates original character-art compositions and text from a date/weather/news brief, which are formatted for physical print.

leads.review_status: Creator’s working installation is documented with photos. Printer compatibility, local setup and assistant costs need a complete guide. leads.name: MCP build123d
leads.good_for: Authoring parametric CAD with an AI agent and exporting measured STEP/STL/GLB artifacts.

ai_relevance.text: An MCP interface lets an LLM construct and execute build123d models, inspect OCCT geometry metrics and retrieve exact exported artifacts.

leads.review_status: The older Casys-AI GitHub URL redirects to this current repository. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: Fabricator
leads.good_for: Iterating on a simple printable object through an AI assistant, previews and a slicer handoff.

ai_relevance.text: Claude authors CAD from a natural-language brief while the project checks geometry and produces preview images for revision.

leads.name: Line-us MCP

ai_relevance.text: The agent supplies declarative scenes through MCP; the server compiles strokes, previews them and can control the Line-us drawing arm.

leads.review_status: Requires the separate Line-us hardware on the local network. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: cypher-dj

ai_relevance.text: A dedicated MCP control interface connects an agent to a shared-clock C++ audio core, with human override and measurement controls.

leads.review_status: Public beta developed and played on one Linux machine; author reports a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 build. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: tf-deep-omr
leads.good_for: Studying end-to-end transcription of monophonic printed staves into symbolic notation.

ai_relevance.text: Uses convolutional recurrent neural networks and CTC training/inference for optical music recognition.

leads.review_status: Historical research baseline from 2018, not a fresh launch or modern turnkey app. TensorFlow compatibility, dataset terms, checkpoints and hardware need a full reproducibility guide. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: Zeus OMR

leads.name: RelightableAvatar

leads.review_status: Author tests Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.10.1/CUDA 11.3 on a 3090-class GPU. SMPL and pretrained models have separate terms; rig, input-data and full setup review remain pending. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: Blender Neural Render Proxy

ai_relevance.text: Bakes path caches, trains a PyTorch neural proxy, previews relighting and differentiates through the proxy to fit a target image.

leads.review_status: A sample reimplementation based on research, prioritizing correctness over real-time performance. leads.name: SlimeMold Artist Explorer

ai_relevance.text: Uses CLIP/Qwen embeddings and SDXL or Anima generation in an interactive evolutionary search over style tags.

leads.review_status: Author explicitly calls this a personal experimental project. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.

leads.name: SVG Animator agent toolkit

leads.review_status: Full runtime setup and viewer compatibility remain pending. Structural checks cannot establish visual correctness in every browser, slide tool, PDF or email client. Software license reviewed; full profile and hands-on output testing remain pending.
